reviewContext.note: RE-review (sprint-4) of the two sprint-3 FAIL findings (FIND-301 fixed gas, FIND-302 manifest fail-closed untested) plus a no-regression sweep of the sprint-3 PASSes and the new AKASH_POLL_SLEEP knob. Both prior findings are now resolved on disk: AKASH_GAS defaults to a fixed numeric 500000 (no --gas auto), justified by the measured deployment-create gasUsed=138662 with ample headroom over cert-publish/lease-create; and the fake gains a `manifest` fail mode with a behavioral case that drives the script through deploy-akash.sh:114-121 and asserts rc!=0 + empty stdout + that send-manifest was actually attempted. No regression to parse fidelity, test non-circularity, fail-closed, or boot-claim honesty. AKASH_POLL_SLEEP defaulting preserves real polling and the test's 0 setting only removes the delay, not iteration/break logic. Sole non-blocking nit: the test:41 mkfake comment still lists modes as ("" | create | nobid | lease), omitting `manifest` — a stale doc string, not a behavioral defect.

evidence.description: FIND-301 RESOLVED. `export AKASH_GAS="${AKASH_GAS:-500000}"` is now a FIXED numeric default, not `auto`. With a numeric gas the broadcast carries `--gas 500000` directly and runs NO simulation round-trip (AKASH_GAS_ADJUSTMENT only multiplies a simulated value, which is dead with fixed gas) — satisfying spec line 43/54 'fixed gas' acceleration fix. The inline comment cites the real measured deployment-create gasUsed=138662, so the constant is justified by a real tx, not invented.

Gas-limit adequacy: the three on-chain txs in the flow are cert publish (MsgCreateCertificate, ~100-200k typical), deployment create (138662 measured), lease create (similar magnitude). 500000 covers each with >2.5x headroom; no single tx plausibly exceeds 500000 to cause an out-of-gas failure. cert generate (line 34) is a local op (no tx).

INV-1 own-wallet (--from $AKASH_KEY_NAME, no console-api/credit-card/managed-wallet), INV-2 ordered cert<deploy<bid<lease<manifest, INV-3 no sleep 30 + bid poll loop, INV-4 cert only if none valid (32-37), INV-5 no mint/swap in active code, INV-6 fail-closed exits — all still hold.

FIND-302 RESOLVED (fake mode). `*"send-manifest"*) [ "$FAIL" = manifest ] && exit 1 || echo "ok" ;;` adds a `manifest` fail mode that makes send-manifest exit non-zero on every retry, while still echoing ok in all other modes (happy path unaffected, non-circularity preserved).

FIND-302 RESOLVED (behavioral case). `runfake manifest` then `ok "$([ $rc -ne 0 ] && [ -z "$OUT" ] ...)"` asserts rc!=0 AND empty stdout (no dseq leak), and line 91 greps `recd` to assert send-manifest was actually attempted. In manifest mode the fake returns happy values for keys/cert/create(code0,dseq777)/bid(open)/lease(code0)/lease-list(active), so the script proceeds all the way to the send-manifest loop and exits 1 at deploy-akash.sh:121 — genuinely exercising lines 114-121, not short-circuiting earlier.

The three prior fail-closed behavioral cases (create code!=0, no bids -> no lease attempt, lease code!=0 -> no manifest) remain valid against the updated shared fake; recd is recorded per-runfake (62,67) so the lease/manifest non-call asserts (83,87) read the correct invocation log.

AKASH_POLL_SLEEP knob (#4): `sleep "${AKASH_POLL_SLEEP:-2}"` defaults to 2 in prod (real polling preserved across bid/lease/manifest loops). Loop termination depends ONLY on bid-found / lease-active / send-manifest-rc=0, never on sleep, so setting it to 0 in the test (test:65) removes the delay without altering iteration count or break conditions — no weakening of any real guarantee.

set -e safety: cert publish uses `|| true`/explicit `||` guard (34-36); the send-manifest call sits inside an `if` (116), and bid/lease results come from command substitution — none trigger premature set -e exit. No new control-flow defect introduced by the edits.

Sole nit (non-blocking): the mkfake header comment still reads `# $1 = fail mode ("" | create | nobid | lease)`, omitting the newly added `manifest` mode handled at line 55. Stale documentation only; the code path is correct and tested. Not severe enough to FAIL structural integrity.

runfake isolates each run in its own temp dir + REC file and tears it down (rm -rf), so the five behavioral runs (happy/create/nobid/lease/manifest) do not cross-contaminate; the manifest case slots cleanly into the existing structure.

Non-circularity preserved: the fake jq-builds the real decoded shapes (EventDeploymentCreated id-attr as a tojson string, .bid.id, lease.state=active) so a parse regression still breaks the happy path; the manifest fail mode is the ONLY change to send-manifest and does not loosen any parse assertion. A regression to the old `select(.key=="dseq")` or `.bid.bid_id` would still empty-out DSEQ/BID and fail test:72-73.

Boot-claim honesty unchanged: the script prints ONLY the dseq (123), reached only after lease-active (113) AND send-manifest rc=0 (121). On a real provider that 400s, the new manifest path means the script exits 1 rather than overclaim a boot. The test does not assert a container boot.

resolvedSincePrior: FIND-301 (--gas auto on default path) — RESOLVED: AKASH_GAS defaults to fixed numeric 500000 (deploy-akash.sh:26), justified by measured gasUsed=138662, covers cert/deploy/lease with headroom; no simulation round-trip.

FIND-302 (send-manifest fail-closed untested) — RESOLVED: `manifest` fail mode (test:55) + behavioral case (test:89-91) drives the script to deploy-akash.sh:114-121 and asserts rc!=0 + empty stdout + send-manifest attempted.
nonFailingNotes: test-deploy-akash.sh:41 mkfake comment omits the `manifest` mode (stale doc string only; behavior at line 55 is correct and tested).
AKASH_POLL_SLEEP (deploy-akash.sh:92,111,119) defaults to 2 in prod (real polling); test sets 0 (sleep delay only, no correctness/iteration impact).
